"""(sum(power**i for i < count) mod 2**64, power**count mod 2**64)."""
    if count <= 0:
        return 0, 1
    if count == 1:
        return 1, power % MODULUS
    if count % 2 == 0:
        half, sq = _geom(power, count // 2)
        return (half * (1 + sq)) & MASK, (sq * sq) & MASK
    total, pw = _geom(power, count - 1)
    return (total + pw) & MASK, (pw * power) & MASK
